admission.justification: Enforces KNO-R13@v1 AC-3 unified foreground-only highlighting across all dashboard viewers while removing all client Lezer language packs and preserving INV-QK8XNM editor retention.

applicability: Dashboard CodeMirror 6 viewers (FilePane, DiffPane, ChangeSetPane, DualPane, ReaderCode, NotesReaderViewer, ExpressionCards, KnowledgeStatements) and dashboard/package.json dependencies.
conditions: serverHighlights.ts maps flat UTF-16 [start, end, tokenIdx] triples into sorted, document-length-clamped Decoration.mark(.cm-ar-tok-*) ranges so malformed spans or drawnText trailing-newline trims never throw.
codemirrorTheme.ts styles .cm-ar-tok-* classes with foreground-only OKLCH colors (zero background overrides) so citationHighlight and diff background bands remain visible.

FilePane and DiffPane reconfigure highlights in place via CodeMirror Compartments keyed on highlightDigest without adding highlights to EditorView/MergeView rebuild dependencies, preserving INV-QK8XNM DOM node retention across unchanged polls.

ChangeSetPane suppresses token highlights by passing highlights={null} in plain (full-file highlight-off) mode, and dashboard/package.json declares no @codemirror/lang-*, @codemirror/language, or @lezer/highlight packages.
exclusions: Server-side tree-sitter execution and span generation (covered by AC-1.2 and AC-2).
Markdown rendered preview mode (which does not use CodeMirror).

evidence: dashboard Vitest 18/18 files (184/184 tests) + npm run build (bundle-budget PASS) + oxlint + tsc -b on clean-copy tree 8e2b8ed2889265fea2a81be8c3fb8e889a194990

statement: Dashboard CodeMirror 6 viewers render server-computed UTF-16 highlight spans via foreground-only Decoration.mark classes and per-side Compartments without hardcoded @codemirror/lang-* packages, preserving INV-QK8XNM DOM node retention across unchanged polls and ChangeSetPane plain-mode suppression.
title: Dashboard viewers render server UTF-16 highlights in place without lang packs
